title: missing debug_assert for OutboundMessageParams::outbox_peers non-empty invariant
description: crates/kith-store/src/lib.rs: OutboundMessageParams.outbox_peers has doc comment 'Must be non-empty' but insert_outbound_message has no debug_assert. The call-site guard in message.rs enforces this today, but the struct is pub and the precondition is invisible at the implementation boundary. Suggested rewrite: add at the top of insert_outbound_message: debug_assert\!(\!params.outbox_peers.is_empty(), "insert_outbound_message requires at least one outbox peer");
